chapterInfo.content:
2
Onipa a ɔkura susuhoma no
1 # Hes 40.3 Na memaa m’ani so mehwɛe, na hwɛ, na ɔbarima bi a susuhoma kura ne nsam nie. 2Na mebisaa sɛ: Ɛhe na worekorɔ? Na ɔbuaa see me sɛ: Merekɔ makɔsusu Yerusalem mahwɛ sɛdeɛ ne trɛ ne ne ntwemu teɛ. 3Na hwɛ, ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me kasaeɛ no firii adi, na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ firii adi kɔhyiaa no, 4#Hes 38.11 na ɔka kyerɛɛ no se: Tu mmirika kɔka kyerɛ aberanteɛ yi sɛ: Yerusalem bɛda hɔ sɛ nkuraankuraa a ɛnni afasuo, nnipa ne mmoa a ɛwɔ mu dodoɔ nti; 5#Sak 9.8 na me deɛ, AWURADE asɛm nie, me ara ankasa na mɛyɛ no ogya fasuo atwa ne ho mahyia, na mayɛ ne mu animuonyam.
6Huu, huu! Monnwane mfiri atifi fam asase so, AWURADE na ɔseɛ, na matrɛ mo mu sɛ ɔsoro mframa nnan no, AWURADE asɛm nie. 7Huu, Sion, bɔ wo ho adwaa, wo a wo ne Babel babaa teɛ no. 8#Deut 32.10 Na sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: N’animuonyam nti na wasoma me amanaman a wɔfom mo no nkyɛn; na deɛ ɔka mo no, waka AWURADE ani kosua. 9Na hwɛ, wɔn so na mɛhwim me nsa na wɔadanedane fomfa adeɛ ama wɔn nkoa, na moahunu sɛ asafo AWURADE na asoma me.
10To ahurisie dwom ma w’ani nnye, Sion babaa, na hwɛ, mereba mabɛtena wo mu, AWURADE asɛm nie. 11#Yes 11.10 Na amanaman bebree de wɔn ho bɛba abɛbɔ AWURADE ho ɛda no, na wɔayɛ me ɔman; na mɛtena wo mu, na wobɛhunu sɛ asafo AWURADE na asoma me wo nkyɛn. 12#Sak 1.17 Na AWURADE bɛfa Yuda adi so sɛ ne kyɛfa asase kronkron no so, na wakɔ so afa Yerusalem ayɛ ne deɛ.
13 # Hab 2.20 Ma akra nyinaa nyɛ komm, AWURADE anim, ɛfiri sɛ wasɔre wɔ ne tenabea kronkron hɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na memaa m’ani so mehwɛe, na hwɛ, na ɔbarima bi a susuhoma kura ne nsam nie. Na mebisaa sɛ: Ɛhe na worekorɔ? Na ɔbuaa see me sɛ: Merekɔ makɔsusu Yerusalem mahwɛ sɛdeɛ ne trɛ ne ne ntwemu teɛ. Na hwɛ, ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔne me kasaeɛ no firii adi, na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ firii adi kɔhyiaa no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no se: Tu mmirika kɔka kyerɛ aberanteɛ yi sɛ: Yerusalem bɛda hɔ sɛ nkuraankuraa a ɛnni afasuo, nnipa ne mmoa a ɛwɔ mu dodoɔ nti; na me deɛ, AWURADE asɛm nie, me ara ankasa na mɛyɛ no ogya fasuo atwa ne ho mahyia, na mayɛ ne mu animuonyam.
Huu, huu! Monnwane mfiri atifi fam asase so, AWURADE na ɔseɛ, na matrɛ mo mu sɛ ɔsoro mframa nnan no, AWURADE asɛm nie. Huu, Sion, bɔ wo ho adwaa, wo a wo ne Babel babaa teɛ no. Na sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie: N’animuonyam nti na wasoma me amanaman a wɔfom mo no nkyɛn; na deɛ ɔka mo no, waka AWURADE ani kosua. Na hwɛ, wɔn so na mɛhwim me nsa na wɔadanedane fomfa adeɛ ama wɔn nkoa, na moahunu sɛ asafo AWURADE na asoma me.
To ahurisie dwom ma w’ani nnye, Sion babaa, na hwɛ, mereba mabɛtena wo mu, AWURADE asɛm nie. Na amanaman bebree de wɔn ho bɛba abɛbɔ AWURADE ho ɛda no, na wɔayɛ me ɔman; na mɛtena wo mu, na wobɛhunu sɛ asafo AWURADE na asoma me wo nkyɛn. Na AWURADE bɛfa Yuda adi so sɛ ne kyɛfa asase kronkron no so, na wakɔ so afa Yerusalem ayɛ ne deɛ.
Ma akra nyinaa nyɛ komm, AWURADE anim, ɛfiri sɛ wasɔre wɔ ne tenabea kronkron hɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
